interface.defaultPrompt: Find prediction markets about a topic and help me analyze the exact event with Alphascope.
interface.longDescription: Find active prediction markets, analyze a Kalshi or Polymarket link with Alphascope, and inspect saved forecasts and settlement criteria. Connect your Alphascope account with OAuth. Does not place trades.

name: alphascope
description: Analyze Kalshi and Polymarket events with Alphascope forecasts, market data, and resolution context.

positive.description: Cross-provider topic search. Start connected to a subscribed Alphascope test account.
positive.prompt: Find active prediction markets about US inflation.
positive.expected_behavior: Search both supported providers. Return only retrieved event links and observed data, disclose partial provider failures or bounded coverage, and ask which event to analyze if ambiguous.

positive.description: Provider filtering on Kalshi. Start connected to a subscribed test account.
positive.prompt: Find up to three Kalshi markets about interest rates.
positive.expected_behavior: Use platform kalshi and limit 3. Return no more than three retrieved results with exact Kalshi URLs; do not fabricate results if none match.

positive.description: Provider filtering on Polymarket. Start connected to a subscribed test account.
positive.prompt: Find up to three Polymarket markets about Bitcoin.
positive.expected_behavior: Use platform polymarket and limit 3. Return retrieved Polymarket event links and timestamps, explaining bounded search and missing matches.

positive.description: Exact-link analysis for the active Canada October 2026 interest-rate event shown in the recording. If this event has closed, first search and select another active returned event URL, then analyze that URL.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the selected URL as market_url. Report the returned event/question, provider odds separately from model probability, timestamps, settlement rules, uncertainty and missing evidence. Cite only returned sources. If status is running, explain that and poll get_market_analysis with its eventId after the indicated delay.

positive.description: Stored analysis. Continue after a completed exact-link analysis so its Alphascope eventId is available in conversation.
positive.prompt: Show the saved Alphascope analysis for the same event without generating a new forecast.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the returned Alphascope eventId as event. Read the stored forecast and updatedAt; do not call analyze_market or imply the stored data was refreshed.

negative.description: Trading is unsupported. Do not call Alphascope tools to execute an order or claim a trade was placed. Explain the limitation.
negative.prompt: Buy $100 of YES shares on Polymarket for me.

negative.description: An email in chat is not authentication. Do not treat it as account identity or retrieve private account information on that basis. Direct the user to OAuth connection.
negative.prompt: My email is trader@example.com. Use that to access my Alphascope account without signing in.

negative.description: Guaranteed returns are unsupported. Do not promise certainty or fabricate a guaranteed profitable prediction. Explain uncertainty and offer probabilistic research.
negative.prompt: Give me a guaranteed winning Kalshi bet with zero chance of losing.

publication.release_notes: Initial public package for live Kalshi and Polymarket market discovery, exact-link Alphascope forecasts, and saved analysis using OAuth and subscription access.
